functions.name: appointment_attendance_event
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ramosolo.appointment_attendance_event()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'ramosolo', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  INSERT INTO appointment_attendance_events(institution_id,appointment_id,appointment_version,kind,status,starts_at,recorded_at)
   VALUES(NEW.institution_id,NEW.id,NEW.schedule_version,'created',NEW.status,NEW.starts_at,timezone('UTC',clock_timestamp()));
 ELSIF ROW(NEW.status,NEW.starts_at,NEW.schedule_version) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.status,OLD.starts_at,OLD.schedule_version) THEN
  INSERT INTO appointment_attendance_events(institution_id,appointment_id,appointment_version,kind,previous_status,status,previous_start,starts_at,recorded_at)
   VALUES(NEW.institution_id,NEW.id,NEW.schedule_version,'changed',OLD.status,NEW.status,OLD.starts_at,NEW.starts_at,timezone('UTC',clock_timestamp()));
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ramosolo.booking_exception_audit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'ramosolo', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO audit_events(institution_id,actor_id,action,resource_type,resource_id,created_at)
 SELECT institution_id,NEW.approved_by,'approve_exception','availability_exception',NEW.id,timezone('UTC',clock_timestamp())
 FROM availability_policies WHERE id=NEW.policy_id;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ramosolo.followup_actor_allowed(inst integer, doctor integer, actor integer, admin_only boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'ramosolo', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memberships m JOIN users u ON u.id=m.user_id JOIN institutions i ON i.id=m.institution_id
 WHERE m.institution_id=inst AND i.kind='medical' AND m.user_id=actor AND m.enabled AND u.enabled
 AND (m.role='admin' OR (NOT admin_only AND (m.role='dr' AND m.user_id=doctor OR m.role='dr_assist' AND m.supervising_doctor_id=doctor)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memberships d JOIN users du ON du.id=d.user_id WHERE d.institution_id=inst AND d.user_id=doctor AND d.role='dr' AND d.enabled AND du.enabled))))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ramosolo.invalidate_reminder_jobs(appointment integer, preference integer, policy integer, why text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'ramosolo', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 UPDATE notification_outbox j SET invalidated_at=timezone('UTC',clock_timestamp()),
  state=CASE WHEN state='pending' THEN 'cancelled' ELSE state END,
  result_code=CASE WHEN state='pending' THEN why ELSE result_code END
 WHERE j.invalidated_at IS NULL AND ((appointment IS NOT NULL AND j.appointment_id=appointment)
  OR (preference IS NOT NULL AND j.preference_id=preference) OR (policy IS NOT NULL AND j.policy_id=policy));
END $function$

constraints.name: appointment_attendance_events_kind_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((kind)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['baseline'::character varying, 'created'::character varying, 'changed'::character varying, 'confirmation_requested'::character varying, 'response_recorded'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: appointment_identity
constraints.definition: CHECK (((patient_id IS NOT NULL) <> (booking_request_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: appointment_interval
constraints.definition: CHECK (((ends_at IS NULL) OR ((ends_at > starts_at) AND (occupied_until >= ends_at))))

constraints.name: appointments_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['scheduled'::character varying, 'held'::character varying, 'expired'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying, 'no_show'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: attendance_followups_state_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['open'::character varying, 'acknowledged'::character varying, 'dismissed'::character varying, 'resolved'::character varying, 'obsolete'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: availability_exceptions_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind)::text <> 'opening'::text) OR (((care_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['inpatient'::character varying, 'outpatient'::character varying])::text[])) AND (opens_at IS NOT NULL) AND (closes_at IS NOT NULL) AND (opens_at < closes_at) AND (duration_minutes IS NOT NULL) AND (first_minutes IS NOT NULL) AND (assessment_minutes IS NOT NULL) AND (break_minutes IS NOT NULL) AND ((first_minutes >= 60) AND (first_minutes <= 120)) AND ((assessment_minutes >= 1) AND (assessment_minutes <= 240)) AND ((break_minutes >= 5) AND (break_minutes <= 10)) AND ((((care_type)::text = 'outpatient'::text) AND ((duration_minutes >= 30) AND (duration_minutes <= 60))) OR (((care_type)::text = 'inpatient'::text) AND ((duration_minutes >= 20) AND (duration_minutes <= 30)))))))

constraints.name: availability_sessions_check2
